{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZYY3cw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhC_v2g", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 69, "title": "Add an evidence-qualified EIC NET environmental-information reading journey", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `531fc0c3ce1a755dd04e52a40fc85f204237624a`, entering MAIN `5 公共情報と政治` displays `記事一覧：0件`. `LIST` only redisplays that empty collection, and `READ 1` is rejected. There is no information-directory-to-reading journey outside the community services.

This advances the intentional placeholder scope of [Issue #33](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/33), rather than reporting that implementation as a regression. Environmental information provides a bounded, historically supported next destination.

## Expected outcome

Provide this keyboard-operated, browser-local journey:

`MAIN → 5 公共情報と政治 → environmental gateway directory → EICネット → article list → article → list → gateway directory → actual parent`

Use `1` to select the EIC NET destination from the gateway directory and the existing application conventions `LIST`, `READ number`, `BACK`, `MAIN`, and `HELP`. These selectors, placement, layouts and controls are explicitly accepted product reconstructions, not recovered historical commands.

Include two or three short, original Japanese readings representing environmental information-source guidance and environmental learning or observation. Suitable subjects include finding environmental reference material and keeping a simple nature-observation record. Keep EIC NET visibly identified as a separate destination reached through a gateway.

## Context

### Historical evidence and reconstruction decision

Sources inspected on 2026-10-23:

- The [NIES environmental-information article](https://www.nies.go.jp/pr/publications/news/14/14-6/14-6-07.html) describes administrative information, information-source guidance and information exchange. Its access instructions explicitly direct PC-VAN users through an other-network/gateway menu to EIC NET. Confidence is high in these displayed purposes and the service distinction. Exact publication chronology remains qualified: the archive identifies fiscal 1995, volume 14 issue 6, while its prose describes a March opening; the indexed PDF is labeled February 1996. Neither source authenticates MAIN 5 placement or destination commands.
- The [operator history](https://www.eic.or.jp/eic/aboutus/) dates EIC NET's opening to March 12, 1996. Confidence is moderate to high for this retrospective organizational chronology; it supplies no terminal layout.
- The Environment Agency's [January 31, 1997 release](https://www.env.go.jp/press/256.html) independently confirms the March 1996 computer-communications launch and explicitly says that text operation would continue alongside the new web service. This corrects any implication of an immediate replacement. Its 1997 web categories and examples must not become a purported November 1996 terminal menu.
- The [August 1996 biodiversity guide](https://www.biodic.go.jp/reports2/5th/96_tebiki/5_96_tebiki.pdf) provides indexed corroboration of PC-VAN gateway access. Its PDF returned no readable text and the page-image attempt failed; treat its details as snippet-only corroboration, not implementation specifications.

Accept thematic placement under MAIN 5 as a disclosed reconstruction. Preserve the existing MAIN label and selector. Do not claim that this was the historical location of the gateway. Original sample prose is illustrative material, not an archived EIC article, official announcement or authentic publication. Any supplied sample date is authored fiction and must not be presented as a recovered date.

Keep source URLs, access dates, historical scope, confidence, unavailable-source limitations and reconstruction assumptions discoverable through existing Settings/About and research documentation. Ordinary terminal screens should remain concise.

### Implementation boundaries

- `src/sections.ts` currently maps MAIN 5 to an empty article collection; `src/navigation.ts` owns selection, rendering and the parent stack.
- `src/service-collections.ts` and [Issue #59](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/59) provide an existing static-reading pattern. Reuse suitable conventions without making EIC NET appear to be a DAISIZEN collection or introducing a generic service framework.
- `src/main.ts` and `src/commands.ts` separately dispatch forum reads, composition, mail and OLT. Information reads must not acquire those contexts or side effects.
- `tests/sections.spec.ts` currently requires MAIN 5 to be empty and rejects reading. Update that obsolete expectation while retaining the other destinations and index-return coverage.
- Update the README destination table, usage guidance, research record and existing About presentation as appropriate.

This Issue covers one information journey. Other MAIN collections, news/database coverage, historical paging, remote connections, credentials, uploads, generation and storage-schema changes are outside scope. Use bundled original text; do not copy archived messages, identities, images or official prose.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] MAIN 5 opens a concise gateway directory; selecting `1` opens a separately identified EIC NET article list containing two or three original readings. Each listed item is readable in full through `READ number` without registering a handle, enabling AI or contacting an external service.
- [ ] `HELP` preserves the current view; `LIST` redisplays the directory/list and returns from an article to its list. `BACK` follows the actual parent at every depth, including entry through `2 索引 → 5`. `MAIN` works from every new depth. Re-entry cannot retain an obsolete article selection or parent.
- [ ] Invalid selectors, malformed/out-of-range read numbers and unrelated service commands produce contextual responses without changing the current view. Information screens expose no forum, mailbox, conference or OLT participation context. `WRITE`, `REPLY`, mail composition and room-entry attempts cannot create records from these screens; existing global application shortcuts remain usable.
- [ ] Bundled readings remain static application content. They do not seed or modify members, SIGs, forums, posts, mail, read markers, conference/OLT records, consent or historical-calendar settings, including in restored worlds with empty community collections. Normal command-history/session activity retains its existing behavior. Do not add persistence or migrations for this content.
- [ ] Settings/About accurately distinguishes evidenced gateway availability and information purposes from reconstructed MAIN placement, selectors, controls and fictional readings. Record the January 1997 evidence that text operation continued alongside web operation; retain unresolved chronology and snippet-only qualifications. Do not transplant modern portal categories into 1996.
- [ ] Add focused controller and production-browser coverage using the existing Playwright tooling and terminal helpers. Cover every reading, contextual errors, direct/index entry and returns, repeated visits, Settings/About return to the current article, literal text rendering, 320px usability and terminal-log inclusion. Exercise browsing with and without a handle and verify protected records remain unchanged in a deterministic fixture with automatic activity paused.
- [ ] Preserve existing functional, storage/import/reset, consent, shared-calendar, composition/IME, terminal scrolling and progressive-output/skip coverage. Run the repository's `npm test` before merge; its configured servers already perform TypeScript checking and the production build. Use existing model stubs where needed. Check the final diff, Markdown/local links and whitespace with existing tools, and report actual results and any failures accurately. No new test framework, real inference or model download is needed.

The existing calendar implementation has recorded Coordinator validation in [PR #68](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/68) and `docs/validation.md`: 249 passing checks and seven focused calendar checks. Those are prior implementation records, not checks run by this research graph or validation of this proposed change.

## Optional validation

Optional visual/readability review of the new Japanese directory and readings. No human confirmation, hardware check, real model run or exact historical screenshot comparison is a completion gate.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. The journey and safeguards are verifiable against production assets before merge.
